coverage.parallelEnglish: Selected allusion/target units read in full; Chinese was primary. No governing Chinese source context omitted.

method: Full governing Chinese contexts, complete current membership, owned claims, mentions and inbound claims assessed before any proposal exposure. Retrospective references are not contemporary activity; English expansions and extracted date hints are not independent proof. Identity conclusions are inferential source judgments, not assertions that every unit explicitly states all aliases. A single weak isolated scholarly attribution remains possible-same-as.

memberConclusions.rationale: Kong Huan contrasts Jiang Zong’s literary brilliance with suitability as tutor, using the paired Pan/Lu literary exemplars. This is retrospective surname allusion to the Jin writer, not the living Lu Yu addressed in the same exchange; the parallel Nanshi account confirms the same allusion.

primaryUnitCitations.zh: 奐謂瑜曰：「江有潘、陸之華，而無園、綺之實，輔弼儲宮，竊有所難。」

memberConclusions.rationale: Lu Ji commands Ying’s attack on the capital and is defeated at Jianchun Gate in Emperor Hui’s annals. This aligns with the Chengdu/Ying–Changsha campaign independently narrated in Jinshu071 and Songshu030; the court writer in the target belongs to the same Jin court milieu.

primaryUnitCitations.zh: 顒遣其將張方，穎遣其將陸機、牽秀、石超等來逼京師。
戊申，破陸機于建春門，石超走，斬其大將賈崇等十六人，懸首銅駝街。

memberConclusions.rationale: The Huangmen official Lu Ji is arrested after Lun’s fall alongside the officers implicated in the abdication text. The exact full Chinese name, court setting and compatible sequence match the target’s former court minister and the Palace Gentleman recruited by Lun in Tongjian083.

primaryUnitCitations.zh: 及倫敗，齊王冏收侍中劉逵、常侍騶捷、杜育、黃門郎陸機、右丞周導、王尊等付廷尉。

memberConclusions.rationale: Target anchor: after the prince’s funeral, the emperor builds the terrace and former ministers Jiang Tong and Lu Ji compose dirges. This is a named Jin court writer, not a later narrator or a generic title.

primaryUnitCitations.zh: 帝感閻纘之言，立思子台，故臣江統、陸機並作誄頌焉。

memberConclusions.rationale: Sun Hui’s biography names Lu Ji as Ying’s vanguard commander against Changsha, a fellow townsman whom Hui advises to yield command to Wang Cui; it then records the execution of Ji and his brothers. The parallel Sanguozhi051 account supplies the same event sequence and names Yun and Dan.

primaryUnitCitations.zh: 是時，穎將征長沙王乂，以陸機為前鋒都督。
惠與機同鄉里，憂其致禍，勸機讓都督于王粹。
及機兄弟被戮，惠甚傷恨之。

memberConclusions.rationale: Lu Chao compares Zong Chang’s literary talent with Wei’s Chen/Xu and Jin’s Pan/Lu. The explicit dynasty plus paired literary exemplars identifies the retrospective Jin literary Lu; it does not place him in Yao Xing’s contemporary court.

primaryUnitCitations.zh: 超曰：「敞在西土，時論甚美，方敞魏之陳、徐，晉之潘、陸。」

memberConclusions.rationale: The passage discusses compilation of Jinshu and Taizong’s four discourses, on the two emperors and Lu Ji and Wang Xizhi. Its named Lu Ji is a historical Jinshu subject, consistent with the target Jin court writer, not a Tang compiler.

primaryUnitCitations.zh: 太宗自著宣、武二帝及陸機、王羲之四論，於是總題云「御撰」。

memberConclusions.rationale: Su Weidao and Li Jiao compare Liu Zhiji’s Sishen fu to Lu Ji’s Haoshi. This is a quoted earlier author, linked by the distinctive work also explicitly attributed to Lu Ji in Nanqishu042.

primaryUnitCitations.zh: 鳳閣侍郎蘇味道、李嶠見而嘆曰：「陸機《豪士》所不及也。」

memberConclusions.rationale: Lu Chui invokes our house’s Pingyuan visiting Zhang Zhuangwu as a literary precedent for Liu Xian’s learned exchange. Songshu081 explicitly supplies Jin Pingyuan Interior Governor Lu Ji. This connects the title allusion; 吾家 is retained only at its stated broad kinship level.

primaryUnitCitations.zh: 陸倕聞之歎曰：「劉郎可謂差人，雖吾家平原詣張壯武，王粲謁伯喈，必無此對。」

memberConclusions.rationale: The literary history explicitly calls Lu Ji the outstanding poet of Taikang with Anren and Jingyang as supporters, after its Jin/Taikang Three Zhangs and Two Lus frame. This is the same Jin literary Lu, with no contemporary Liang activity implied.

primaryUnitCitations.zh: 陸機爲太康之英，安仁、景陽爲輔；

memberConclusions.rationale: The advice on poetry places Anren and Shiheng before Yan Yanzhi and contrasts Xie Lingyun. It is a retrospective literary model; the Lu Shiheng form in Xintangshu078 and parallel Nanshi043 confirm the same courtesy-name exemplar. The personal-name expansion is contextual rather than spelled out in this Chinese sentence.

primaryUnitCitations.zh: 但康樂放蕩，作體不辨有首尾，安仁、士衡深可宗尚，顏延之抑 其次也。」

memberConclusions.rationale: The historian explicitly names Lu Ji as author of Haoshi in an argument about talented retainers and patrons; the matching named author/work in Jiutangshu106 is a substantive identity bridge.

primaryUnitCitations.zh: 陸機所以賦豪士也。

memberConclusions.rationale: The complete Kong Huan/Jiang Zong tutoring dispute parallels Chenshu021 and uses precisely Pan/Lu brilliance against Yuan/Qi substance. It is the same literary Lu exemplar, not Lu Yu who carries the request.

primaryUnitCitations.zh: 奐曰：「江有潘、陸之華，而無園、綺之實，輔弼儲貳，竊謂非材。」

memberConclusions.rationale: The poetic advice repeats the Anren/Shiheng comparison in Nanqishu035; the literary courtesy-name referent is the Lu Shiheng historical author, not the Qi prince receiving the advice.

primaryUnitCitations.zh: 但康樂放蕩，作體不辨有首尾，安仁、士衡深可宗尚，顏延之抑其次也。」

memberConclusions.rationale: The threatened prince recites Lu Ji’s Diao Wei Wu, quoting the dead ruler entrusting beloved sons. This names an earlier author and a literary work; it supports the Jin writer identity and does not make him a participant in the Qi execution.

primaryUnitCitations.zh: 及延興元年，明帝誅高、武、文惠諸子，鏗聞之，馮左右從容雅步，詠陸機吊魏武云：「昔以四海為己任，死則以愛子托人。」

memberConclusions.rationale: Pei’s enclosed annotation explains a coffin word by quoting Lu Ji’s Damu fu alongside Han material. Lu Ji is the author of the cited rhapsody, not a participant in Cao Pi’s order; the retrospective literary referent matches the Jin writer.

primaryUnitCitations.zh: 陸機大墓賦曰：「觀細木而悶遲，覩洪櫝而念槥。」〉

memberConclusions.rationale: The Hui supplementary biography gives the same Ying/Changsha vanguard appointment, advice to defer to Wang Cui and execution as Jinshu071, with brothers Yun and Dan. This is a detailed event identity bridge.

primaryUnitCitations.zh: 是时颖将有事於长沙，以陆机为前锋都督。
惠与机乡里亲厚，忧其致祸，谓之曰：“子盍让都督於王粹乎？”
机曰：“将谓吾避贼首鼠，更速其害。”
机寻被戮，二弟云、耽亦见杀，惠甚伤恨之。

memberConclusions.rationale: Sun Cheng is summoned as sima by Lu Ji as Chengdu prince’s grand commander and dies with him. This agrees with the Ying/Changsha commander and execution narrative elsewhere in the packet; the local Yong’an label does not create a different Lu Ji.

primaryUnitCitations.zh: 永安中，陆机为成都王大都督，请丞为司马，与机俱被害。〉

memberConclusions.rationale: The Gu Tan biography quotation explicitly credits Lu Ji as the biographer. It is a retrospective source attribution about Wu’s crown prince, not evidence that the author was active at that narrated moment. Its writer identity agrees with the Jin literary Lu.

primaryUnitCitations.zh: 〈陆机为谭传曰：宣太子正位东宫，天子方隆训导之义，妙简俊彦，讲学左右。

memberConclusions.rationale: The annotation names Wu-commandery Lu Ji, recognized in childhood by Yu Zhong and later famous. Zhong’s death during Jin’s conquest and the target’s subsequent Jin court setting are compatible. The specific Chinese name, Wu origin and later fame fit the Wu/Jin Lu network attested in the Hui and He Xun annotations; no numeric birth date is inferred.

primaryUnitCitations.zh: 贞固幹事，好识人物，造吴郡陆机於童龀之年，称上虞魏迁於无名之初，终皆远致，为著闻之士。

memberConclusions.rationale: The He Xun annotation quotes Gu Rong, Lu Ji and Lu Yun jointly recommending He Xun after Wu’s fall. It supplies the same Wu-to-Jin literary/officer circle and Yun association as the commander narratives. Co-memorialist is not independently promoted to a new family edge.

primaryUnitCitations.zh: 顾荣、陆机、陆云表荐循曰：“伏见吴兴武康令贺循德量邃茂，才鉴清远，服膺道素，风操凝峻，历践三城，刑政肃穆，守职下县，编名凡萃，出自新邦，朝无知己，恪居遐外，志不自营，年时倏忽，而邈无阶绪，实州党愚智所为怅然。
臣等并以凡才，累授饰进，被服恩泽，忝豫朝末，知良士后时，而守局无言，惧有蔽贤之咎，是以不胜愚管，谨冒死表闻。”

memberConclusions.rationale: The omen account explicitly gives Hui’s Taian second year, Chengdu prince Ying, Lu Ji’s campaign against Changsha Yi, defeat and execution. This independently anchors the detailed military chain in Jinshu004/071 and Sanguozhi051.

primaryUnitCitations.zh: 晉惠帝太安二年，成都王穎使陸機率眾向京師，擊長沙王乂。
軍始引而牙竿折，俄而戰敗，機被誅。
機又以穎得遐邇心，將為漢之代王，遂委質於穎，為犯從之將。

memberConclusions.rationale: Yan Yanzhi and Xie Lingyun are praised as unrivalled since Pan Yue and Lu Ji. The full names and retrospective literary pairing align with the Jin Pan/Lu and Taikang context elsewhere; the later eulogized author’s death is not Lu Ji’s date.

primaryUnitCitations.zh: 延之與陳郡謝靈運俱以詞彩齊名，自潘岳、陸機之後，文士莫及也，江左稱顏、謝焉。

memberConclusions.rationale: Gu Jizhi’s genealogy explicitly describes Gu Qian as brother-in-law of Jin Pingyuan Interior Governor Lu Ji. The full name plus Jin/Pingyuan designation links the title allusion in Liangshu040. This does not authorize importing a new exact kinship claim into the target.

primaryUnitCitations.zh: 高祖謙，字公讓，晉平原內史陸機姊夫。

memberConclusions.rationale: The philosophical argument quotes Shiheng on same stream/different destinations. This is the literary Shiheng exemplar linked by the Lu Shiheng spelling and the poetry-comparison records; it is not a new contemporary Song official.

primaryUnitCitations.zh: 樊生沖矯，鐫旌善之文，華子高抗，銘懲非之策，皆士衡所雲「同川而異歸」者也。

memberConclusions.rationale: The historian compares Lu Kang’s Xiling killing with Ji and Yun being executed in the upper state. The Ji/Yun pair and execution align with the explicit Lu Ji and brothers in Sanguozhi051 and Jinshu071; the rhetorical consequence does not establish a new precise genealogical relationship.

primaryUnitCitations.zh: 陸抗定西陵，步氏禍及嬰孩，而機、雲為戮上國。

memberConclusions.rationale: Yuan Xi’s impending-death letter pairs Li Si remembering the yellow dog with Lu Ji remembering Huating cranes. It is expressly an earlier death allusion, consistent with the executed Jin writer; the letter’s own time cannot date Lu Ji’s life.

primaryUnitCitations.zh: 昔李斯憶上蔡黃犬，陸機想華亭鶴唳，豈不以恍惚無際，一去不還者乎？

memberConclusions.rationale: The literary preface explicitly calls Lu Ji the outstanding talent of Jin, set against Cao Zhi of Wei before the Yongjia collapse. This is the Jin literary referent. Yuan Yue’s separate biography begins at s0014 and is not Lu Ji’s historicity evidence.

primaryUnitCitations.zh: 曹植信魏世之英，陸機則晉朝之秀，雖同時並列，分途爭遠。
袁躍，字景騰，陳郡人，尚書翻弟也。

memberConclusions.rationale: Xiao Yan’s praise says Cao Zhi and Lu Ji have been reborn in the north in Wen Zisheng’s writing. It is a metaphor naming earlier literary models, consistent with the preface’s explicit Jin Lu Ji, not literal rebirth or contemporary Wei activity.

primaryUnitCitations.zh: 衍稱之曰：「曹植、陸機復生於北土。

memberConclusions.rationale: The treatise introduction credits Lu Ji with a scholarly objection to Ban’s separation of the seven luminaries across two treatises. This is compatible with the Jin literary scholar and contains no rival identity marker. However, unlike the military or named-work bridges, the sealed packet gives no independently identifying office, courtesy name, date or linked work for this isolated remark; exact full name plus generic authorship alone is insufficient for a confident merge. Preserve this pair as possible-same-as pending a source bridge.

primaryUnitCitations.zh: 七曜一也，而分為二志，故陸機云學者所疑也。

memberConclusions.rationale: The enfeoffment debate explicitly names Lu Shiheng and later recalls Cao/Lu. This supplies the Lu surname and Shiheng courtesy form within a retrospective authored-argument context, connecting the Shiheng literary allusions. No date or new work title is inferred.

primaryUnitCitations.zh: 又舉春秋二百四十二年之禍，亟於哀、平、桓、靈，而詆曹元首、陸士衡之言以為繆悠。
大抵與曹、陸相上下。

memberConclusions.rationale: Lun recruits Palace Gentleman Lu Ji as an adjutant among reputed men. The exact name and court career agree with the Huangmen official implicated after Lun’s fall in Jinshu047 and the target’s former minister; it is compatible succession of roles, not a conflicting identity.

primaryUnitCitations.zh: 相國倫欲收入望，選用海內名德之士，以前平陽太守李重、滎陽太守荀組為左、右長史，東平王堪、沛國劉謨為左、右司馬，尚書郎陽平束皙為記室，淮南王文學荀嵩、殿中郎陸機為參軍。

factualQAOutsideIdentityConclusions.finding: The AD 520 claim describes the letter narrator’s context. The text invokes an earlier Lu Ji; this claim must not be used as his activity date. Identity review does not repair or approve it.
The quoted Chinese remark supplies no AD 289 date. No chronology approval is granted.
s0014 begins Yuan Yue’s biography and cannot independently establish Lu Ji’s historicity.
The preface distinguishes Wei’s Cao Zhi and Jin’s Lu Ji; its phrase 雖同時並列 is not a sound basis for certifying literal contemporaneity across the two exemplars.
The two parallel 園、綺 allusions receive inconsistent personal-name expansions in English. This is separate editorial QA; no correction is authored or certified here.

Several records give imported Western lifetime/career bounds and broad family associations. These were not used as positive identity proof and are not date/family approvals. External chapters remain identity evidence only.

limitations: Source-only blind assessment. Exact author proposal comparison remains pending.
No structural/schema/SDK/core validation, full CI, chronology, editorial, canonical publication or live qualification is certified.
The weishu111 isolated remark requires a stronger source bridge before a confident merge; possible-same-as retains separate records.
